title: Smoked Salmon French Jjigae
description: A unique French-inspired jjigae dish featuring smoked salmon, perfect for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: scottish
ingredients.notes: Scottish whisky or other whisky of choice

ingredients.name: clay
ingredients.notes: dried clay or earthenware powder (for earthy flavor)

instructions: In the donabe, heat 1 tablespoon of oil and sauté the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the smoked salmon and stir to combine with the onion and garlic.
Pour in the Scottish whisky, scraping the bottom of the pot to release all the flavorful bits.
Add the thyme and clay powder, stirring to combine.
Cover the donabe and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
